proposals.evidence: DEDR4990 gives Kannada moṟa kāl, Malayalam muẓaṅ kāl and Kota mogāl knee alongside the joint/cubit stem; DEDR1479 independently documents kāl leg in each language. Propose the ordered joint + leg components for survey muṇakālo, mul̪aŋkāl or mōgāl, preserving their full spelling and the fused Kota form. These are not shortened to the first constituent.

Propose the ordered head + hair components for the complete two-word manḍə mīrə response; neither component nor the final vowels are discarded.

proposals.evidence: DEDR5373 documents Tamil/Malayalam vāḻai/vāḻa, Kannada bāḻe and Kota vāy vaṇ plantain; DEDR4004 independently documents paḻam/paṇ/paṇṇu fruit, including Irula pammu/pāmu and Kota paṇ. Propose the ordered banana-plant + ripe-fruit components for these surveyed whole words. Their lateral/rhotic/glide, p/h and final-vowel differences are preserved. This is a comparative compound analysis for this survey lect, not a claim that every spelling or lect is printed in DEDR; inheritance versus local transmission remains subject to review. More heavily contracted forms without two identifiable constituents are excluded.

proposals.evidence: DEDR1173 gives Kota gaṇḍ ‘male’ and DEDR4616 gives Kota mog ‘child, wife’, explicitly showing the parallel female compound pe-mog ‘woman’. Survey ganmagu ‘man’ is proposed as male + person/child, with the gaṇḍ/gan and mog/magu differences retained; this is a comparative compound analysis, not a claim that the whole survey spelling is printed in DEDR.

proposals.evidence: DEDR474 and3918 explicitly document Tamil/Malayalam iru-patu/iru-vatu twenty, Kannada irpattu/ippattu, Kodagu iru-vadï and Kota irvād. Propose ordered two × ten components for the selected southern survey forms, preserving assimilated pp/bb, initial-glide variants and final vowels. Minority-lect forms are comparative extensions; neighbouring Gondi/Gadaba/Konda contact-sensitive numeral sets are excluded.
